_comment: The repository's cart (tools/sdcard/mkcard.py, `chgame card`), as a recipe for `chgame cart build` (tools/chcart/cli.py): the programs in menu order by sketch name, the two apps in a folder. Each sketch's chgame.json gives its title, details and SD files. menu.png beside this file is the menu's picture, with the CHGAME logo in it: edit it (any paint program) or put any picture there, then `chgame card` (docs/menu-image.md).
title: CHGame Casino
author: bateske
description: The CHGame board package's twenty casino games, with the STL viewer and the SD card reader.
